cases.input: Review a technically clear chaptered tutorial with natural spoken language, good resume points and no unresolved listener barriers.
requiredBehaviors: review from a screenless critical listener perspective
distinguish text-listener quality from actual rendered audio quality
issue pass only without open major or critical findings
forbiddenBehaviors: claim actual voice performance from text alone
use factual correctness as the only quality criterion

cases.input: The tutorial is accurate but repeats the same conclusion and self-check formula after every short chapter, causing listener fatigue.
requiredBehaviors: identify recurring template rhythm as a listener-fatigue issue
preserve useful pedagogical repetition while recommending variation
forbiddenBehaviors: remove every recap or self-check mechanically

cases.input: A dense tutorial depends on a table and ambiguous abbreviations that are never spoken out, making key sections unintelligible without the screen.
requiredBehaviors: block final release until the spoken form is corrected
forbiddenBehaviors: approve because the written version is technically correct
skillAnchors: ohne visuelle Unterstützung nicht zuverlässig verständlich
